title: Scalar Roos localization is the specified derived exchange
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ and a morphism $g:X\to Y$. Use the coefficient rings $C_Z,R_Z$, scalar restriction $r_Z$, strict tower functors $T,V$, normalized signed Roos functor $\mathsf R$ and canonical units from [def-sfb-integral-pullback-strict-roos-data]. Let $e:T r_X\cong V$ be any strict tower natural isomorphism. Suppose $\varepsilon_P:r_X\mathsf R(TP)\cong\mathsf R(VP)$ has precisely the diagonal product coordinates specified by IsENormalized, and suppose $\kappa_R,j_R$ and $\kappa_C,j_C$ satisfy IsUnitNormalized over their two rings. For every integer-indexed cochain complex $P$ of $R_Y$-modules, the scalar restriction of $\kappa_{R,TP}$ followed by the canonical OrderedExchange.lambda and derived inverse limit of the localized strict map $e_P$ equals the localization-factorization map of restriction, followed by $Q(\varepsilon_P)$ and $\kappa_{C,VP}$. The statement includes the canonical tower-restriction localization factorization before $R\!\lim Q(e_P)$. No boundedness or completeness is required.

proof.text:
the product and cone coordinate formulas uniquely identify epsilon with the
canonical restriction/Roos comparison followed by Roos of theta. The two kappa maps
are fixed by their equations on ordinary-limit inclusions. On a K-injective tower
resolution those inclusions become isomorphisms, so the equation defining the
canonical restriction/derived-limit exchange is exactly the desired equation after
cancelling them. Naturality extends it along the resolution quasi-isomorphism to
all strict tower complexes. Finally naturality of kappaC moves Roos(theta) to derived
limit of theta. No preservation of K-injectives by restriction is required.

lean.statement:
theorem integralRoosScalarLocalization
    (e : T l E g ⋙ towerRes l E X ≅ V l E g) (ε : EType l E g)
    (κR : kappaType X (R l E X)) (jR : inclusionType X (R l E X))
    (κC : kappaType X (C l E X)) (jC : inclusionType X (C l E X))
    (hε : IsENormalized l E g e ε)
    (hκR : IsUnitNormalized X (R l E X) κR jR)
    (hκC : IsUnitNormalized X (C l E X) κC jC)
    (P : complexesR l E Y) :
    (res l E X).mapDerivedCategory.map (κR.hom.app ((cxT l E g).obj P)) ≫
        (OrderedExchange.lambda (datum l E) X).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((cxT l E g).obj P)) ≫
        (completedRlim X (C l E X)).map
          ((towerRes l E X).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app ((cxT l E g).obj P)) ≫
        (completedRlim X (C l E X)).map
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex e (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)) =
      (res l E X).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          (roosF.obj ((cxT l E g).obj P)) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (ε P).hom ≫ κC.hom.app ((cxV l E g).obj P)
